text.EN: I'm fine. Don't make a thing of it.
text.TL: Mabuti ako. Huwag mo nang palakihin.

text.EN: Nothing wrong with me. Keep your eyes on the road.
text.TL: Walang mali sa akin. Tumutok ka sa daan.

text.EN: No injuries to report. Step back.
text.TL: Walang sugat na dapat sabihin. Umatras ka.

text.EN: I'm in fighting shape. Don't worry about me.
text.TL: Kaya ko pang lumaban. Huwag mo akong alalahanin.

text.EN: Not a scratch on me. That's all you get.
text.TL: Kahit gasgas wala ako. Iyon lang ang masasabi ko.

text.EN: I'm completely healthy. Leave it alone.

text.EN: Body's holding up just fine. Mind your own health.
text.TL: Maayos ang katawan ko. Asikasuhin mo ang sarili mong kalusugan.

text.EN: I'm intact and able-bodied. Let's move on.

text.EN: No wounds, no sickness. Keep your distance.

text.EN: Doing wonderfully, thank you. It's comforting that you asked.
text.TL: Napakaganda ng kalagayan ko, salamat. Nakakapanatag na nagtanong ka.

text.EN: In great health today. Ready to face whatever comes our way.

text.EN: Feeling well rested and sound. Appreciate the kind check-in.
text.TL: Mabuti ang pahinga at kalagayan ko. Salamat sa magandang pangangamusta.

text.EN: No bumps or scrapes today. Thank you for caring.
text.TL: Walang pasa o gasgas ngayon. Salamat sa pagmamalasakit.

text.EN: I'm doing great, honestly. Let's make sure we both stay that way.
text.TL: Maayos talaga ako. Siguraduhin nating manatili tayong parehong ganito.
